BiblicalUsage: Pith'om means suddenly, in an instant. Babylon is suddenly fallen in Jeremiah 51:8, and Proverbs 3:25 tells me not to fear sudden fear or the desolation of the wicked. But Malachi 3:1 promises the Lord shall suddenly come to His temple — the same suddenness, for mercy instead of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe suddenness belongs to God — He comes without warning, whether to judge or to save.
